```python
    http_status = 422


@dataclass
class CartItem:
    sku: str
    qty: int
    added_unit_cents: int | None = None     # price when it was put in the cart
    gift_card: bool = False


@dataclass
class PricedLine:
    sku: str
    qty: int
    unit_cents: int
    list_unit_cents: int
    source: str
    on_sale: bool
    discount_cents: int = 0
    tax_cents: int = 0
    tax_class: str = STANDARD
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def subtotal_cents(self) -> int:
        return self.unit_cents * self.qty


@dataclass
class PricedCart:
    currency: str
    lines: list[PricedLine] = field(default_factory=list)
    coupon_code: str | None = None
    coupon_discount_cents: int = 0
    promo_discount_cents: int = 0
    shipping_cents: int = 0
    shipping_breakdown: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    tax_cents: int = 0
    messages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def subtotal_cents(self) -> int:
        return sum(l.subtotal_cents for l in self.lines)

    @property
    def total_cents(self) -> int:
        return self.subtotal_cents - self.coupon_discount_cents - self.promo_discount_cents + self.shipping_cents + self.tax_cents


def price_cart(items: list[CartItem], products: dict[str, Product], *, engine: PricingEngine, ship_to: Address,
               weight_g: int, at: datetime, tier: str = "standard", member: bool = False,
               coupon_code: str | None = None, coupons: dict[str, Coupon] | None = None, promotions=(),
               tax_classes: dict[str, str] | None = None, currency: str | None = None,
               settings: Settings = SETTINGS, metrics: dict | None = None) -> PricedCart:
    """Price a cart. Order of operations: unit prices (engine: lists, schedules, floor), member
    prices, automatic promotions, coupon, tax per line on what's left after discounts, shipping.
    Messages are shown to the shopper (price changes, rejected coupons, unavailable items)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    trace = settings.flag("cart_trace")
    currency = currency or settings.default_currency
    coupons = coupons or {}
    tax_classes = tax_classes or {}
    stats = Counter()
    cart = PricedCart(currency)
    if trace:
        log.info("INC-2390 TRACE cart start items=%s tier=%s member=%s coupon=%s currency=%s ship_to=%s/%s",
                 [(i.sku, i.qty) for i in items], tier, member, coupon_code, currency, ship_to.country, ship_to.postcode)

    # --- lines -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if len(items) > MAX_CART_LINES:
        raise CartError(f"a cart can hold at most {MAX_CART_LINES} different items", lines=len(items))
    merged: dict[str, CartItem] = {}
    for it in items:
        # the app sent the same SKU twice when the add button was tapped fast (INC-2390): merge them
        if it.sku in merged:
            merged[it.sku].qty += it.qty
            stats["merged_lines"] += 1
        else:
            merged[it.sku] = CartItem(it.sku, it.qty, it.added_unit_cents, it.gift_card)
    for it in merged.values():
        if it.qty < 1:
            stats["zero_qty"] += 1
            continue
        product = products.get(it.sku)
        if product is None or not product.is_purchasable():
            cart.messages.append(f"{it.sku} is no longer available and was removed.")
            stats["unavailable"] += 1
            continue
        t_line = time.perf_counter()
        if it.gift_card:
            # gift cards are sold at face value: no price list, no sale, no member price, no tax
            line = PricedLine(it.sku, it.qty, product.price_cents, product.price_cents, "gift_card", False,
                              tax_class=GIFT_CARD_TAX_CLASS)
        else:
            point = engine.price(product, it.qty, currency=currency, tier=tier, at=at)
            regular = engine.regular_price(product, it.qty, currency, tier, at)
            unit, source = point.unit_cents, point.source
            on_sale = point.compare_at_cents is not None
            if member:
                try:
                    member_point = engine.price(product, it.qty, currency=currency, tier=MEMBER_PRICE_LIST_TIER, at=at)
                    if member_point.source.startswith("list:") and member_point.unit_cents < unit:
                        unit, source = member_point.unit_cents, member_point.source
                        on_sale = False         # a member price is not a sale (coupons still apply to it)
                        stats["member_priced"] += 1
                except Exception as e:          # the member list may not exist in every currency
                    log.info("INC-2390 member price lookup failed for %s: %s", it.sku, e)
            line = PricedLine(it.sku, it.qty, unit, regular.unit_cents, source, on_sale,
                              tax_class=tax_classes.get(it.sku, STANDARD))
            if point.floored:
                line.notes.append("price floor applied")
                stats["floored"] += 1
        if it.added_unit_cents is not None and it.added_unit_cents != line.unit_cents:
            moved = abs(line.unit_cents - it.added_unit_cents) * 10_000 // max(it.added_unit_cents, 1)
            if moved > PRICE_CHANGE_NOTICE_BP:
                cart.messages.append(f"The price of {product.title} changed since you added it.")
                stats["price_changed"] += 1
        cart.lines.append(line)
        if trace:
            log.info("INC-2390 TRACE line sku=%s qty=%d unit=%d list=%d source=%s sale=%s took=%.1fms", line.sku,
                     line.qty, line.unit_cents, line.list_unit_cents, line.source, line.on_sale,
                     (time.perf_counter() - t_line) * 1000)
    t_lines = time.perf_counter()
    if not cart.lines:
        cart.messages.append("Your cart is empty.")
        return cart

    # --- automatic promotions (best single rule, see promotions.rules) -------------------------------------
    if promotions:
        from shopkit.orders.models import Order, OrderLine
        as_order = Order("cart", [OrderLine(l.sku, l.qty, l.unit_cents) for l in cart.lines if l.tax_class != GIFT_CARD_TAX_CLASS],
                         currency=currency)
        from shopkit.promotions.rules import best_discount
        rule, amount = best_discount(as_order, list(promotions))
        if amount:
            cart.promo_discount_cents = amount
            cart.messages.append(f"Promotion applied: {type(rule).__name__}.")
            # spread the promotion over the lines it touched, for per-line tax
            touched = [l for l in cart.lines if l.tax_class != GIFT_CARD_TAX_CLASS]
            base = sum(l.subtotal_cents for l in touched)
            left = amount
            for i, l in enumerate(touched):
                share = amount * l.subtotal_cents // base if i < len(touched) - 1 else left
                l.discount_cents += share
                left -= share
            stats["promo_applied"] += 1
    t_promos = time.perf_counter()

    # --- coupon ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Percentage coupons don't discount items that are already on sale, or gift cards. On-sale items
    # still count towards the coupon's minimum order value (merchandising rule, 2025-04: "the minimum
    # is about basket size, the exclusion is about margin"). Fixed-amount coupons apply to the whole
    # eligible subtotal (gift cards excluded), never more than it. Printed coupon codes (SAVEnn-YYYY-XXXX)
    # are honoured as percentage coupons with the same exclusions and no minimum.
    if coupon_code:
        code = normalize_code(coupon_code)
        coupon = coupons.get(code)
        printed_pct = None
        if coupon is None:
            printed_pct = parseCouponCode(code)
            if printed_pct:
                coupon = Coupon(code, PERCENT, printed_pct, at.date(), at.date())
                stats["printed_coupon"] += 1
        if coupon is None:
            cart.messages.append(f"The code {code} isn't valid.")
            stats["coupon_invalid"] += 1
        else:
            not_gift = [l for l in cart.lines if l.tax_class != GIFT_CARD_TAX_CLASS]
            basket = sum(l.subtotal_cents - l.discount_cents for l in not_gift)          # counts sale items
            if coupon.kind == PERCENT:
                eligible = [l for l in not_gift if not l.on_sale]
            else:
                eligible = not_gift
            eligible_base = sum(l.subtotal_cents - l.discount_cents for l in eligible)
            try:
                if not coupon_is_active(coupon, at.date()):
                    raise CouponRejected(f"coupon {coupon.code} is not active", code=coupon.code)
                if printed_pct is None and basket < coupon.min_order_cents:
                    raise CouponRejected(f"coupon {coupon.code} needs a larger order", code=coupon.code,
                                         min_order_cents=coupon.min_order_cents)
                if coupon.kind == PERCENT:
                    total_off = apply_rate(eligible_base, coupon.value)
                else:
                    total_off = min(coupon.value, eligible_base)
                # old behaviour (before INC-2390), percentage of the whole basket including sale items:
                # total_off = apply_rate(basket, coupon.value) if coupon.kind == PERCENT else min(coupon.value, basket)
                left = total_off
                for i, l in enumerate(eligible):
                    base_l = l.subtotal_cents - l.discount_cents
                    share = total_off * base_l // eligible_base if (eligible_base and i < len(eligible) - 1) else left
                    l.discount_cents += share
                    left -= share
                cart.coupon_code = coupon.code
                cart.coupon_discount_cents = total_off
                if coupon.kind == PERCENT and len(eligible) < len(not_gift):
                    cart.messages.append("Items already on sale aren't discounted by this code.")
                stats["coupon_applied"] += 1
                if trace:
                    log.info("INC-2390 TRACE coupon %s kind=%s value=%d basket=%d eligible=%d off=%d", coupon.code,
                             coupon.kind, coupon.value, basket, eligible_base, total_off)
            except CouponRejected as e:
                cart.messages.append(str(e).replace("coupon ", "The code ", 1) + ".")
                stats["coupon_rejected"] += 1
    t_coupon = time.perf_counter()

    # --- tax per line, on the discounted amount ----------------------------------------------------------------
    for l in cart.lines:
        taxable = l.subtotal_cents - l.discount_cents
        rate = rate_for(ship_to.country, ship_to.region, l.tax_class)
        l.tax_cents = apply_rate(taxable, rate) if taxable > 0 else 0
    cart.tax_cents = sum(l.tax_cents for l in cart.lines)
    # INC-2390 shadow: tax on the order total (how checkout.quote does it) for comparison
    shadow = 0
    for l in cart.lines:
        shadow += apply_rate(l.subtotal_cents, rate_for(ship_to.country, ship_to.region, l.tax_class))
    if cart.coupon_discount_cents or cart.promo_discount_cents:
        pre = cart.subtotal_cents
        shadow = shadow * (pre - cart.coupon_discount_cents - cart.promo_discount_cents) // pre if pre else 0
    if abs(shadow - cart.tax_cents) > len(cart.lines):
        log.info("INC-2390 tax differs from quote-style tax by %d cents", cart.tax_cents - shadow)
        stats["tax_shadow_diff"] += 1

    # --- shipping ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    goods_only = all(l.tax_class == GIFT_CARD_TAX_CLASS for l in cart.lines)
    if goods_only:
        cart.shipping_cents = 0                 # gift cards are emailed
    else:
        after_discounts = sum(l.subtotal_cents - l.discount_cents for l in cart.lines if l.tax_class != GIFT_CARD_TAX_CLASS)
        try:
            quote = shipping_quote(ship_to.country, ship_to.postcode, weight_g, after_discounts)
            cart.shipping_cents = quote["total"]
            cart.shipping_breakdown = quote
        except TooHeavy as e:
            cart.messages.append("This order is too heavy to ship as one parcel; we'll contact you.")
            cart.shipping_cents = 0
            log.warning("INC-2390 too heavy cart %d g: %s", weight_g, e)
            stats["too_heavy"] += 1
    t_end = time.perf_counter()

    # --- metrics ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if metrics is not None:
        metrics["cart.priced"] = metrics.get("cart.priced", 0) + 1
        for k, v in stats.items():
            metrics["cart." + k] = metrics.get("cart." + k, 0) + v
        metrics["cart.last_ms"] = round((t_end - t0) * 1000, 2)
    if (t_end - t0) > 0.25:
        log.warning("INC-2390 slow cart pricing %.0f ms (lines %.0f, promos %.0f, coupon %.0f)", (t_end - t0) * 1000,
                    (t_lines - t0) * 1000, (t_promos - t_lines) * 1000, (t_coupon - t_promos) * 1000)
    if trace:
        log.info("INC-2390 TRACE cart done %s", json.dumps({"subtotal": cart.subtotal_cents, "coupon": cart.coupon_discount_cents,
                                                         "promo": cart.promo_discount_cents, "tax": cart.tax_cents,
                                                         "shipping": cart.shipping_cents, "total": cart.total_cents}))
    return cart
```

```python
"""The storefront price for a SKU, quantity, currency and customer.

Order of precedence:
1. a scheduled sale active now (lowest wins), unless the customer's price list is lower
2. the customer's price list (tier lists first, then by priority), with quantity breaks
3. a permanent scheduled price change, else the product's list price (in the shop currency),
   converted with the day's pinned rate and rounded to the currency's price ending

The result never goes below the floor price (cost + minimum margin) when a cost is known; the floor
exists because of the "-90% typo" incident (a price list row entered as 1.99 instead of 19.99).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime

from shopkit.catalog.models import Product
from shopkit.config import SETTINGS, Settings
from shopkit.pricing.currency import RateTable
from shopkit.pricing.endings import apply_ending
from shopkit.pricing.price_lists import NoPrice, PriceListSet
from shopkit.pricing.schedules import Schedule

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MIN_MARGIN_BP = 500           # 5% over cost


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PricePoint:
    unit_cents: int
    currency: str
    source: str                      # "sale:<label>", "list:<code>", "schedule", "converted", "list_price"
    compare_at_cents: int | None = None   # the struck-through "was" price on the product page
    floored: bool = False


@dataclass
class PricingEngine:
    price_lists: PriceListSet = field(default_factory=PriceListSet)
    schedule: Schedule = field(default_factory=Schedule)
    rates: RateTable = field(default_factory=RateTable)
    costs: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)       # sku -> unit cost in the shop currency
    settings: Settings = SETTINGS

    def floor_cents(self, sku: str, currency: str, at: datetime) -> int | None:
        cost = self.costs.get(sku)
        if cost is None:
            return None
        floor = cost + cost * MIN_MARGIN_BP // 10_000
        if currency != self.settings.default_currency:
            floor = self.rates.convert(floor, self.settings.default_currency, currency, at.date())
        return floor

    def regular_price(self, product: Product, qty: int, currency: str, tier: str,
                      at: datetime) -> PricePoint:
        """Price without sales: price list, else scheduled base price, else converted list price."""
        try:
            cents, code = self.price_lists.resolve(product.sku, qty, currency, tier)
            return PricePoint(cents, currency, f"list:{code}")
        except NoPrice:
            pass
        base = self.schedule.base_price(product.sku, currency, at)
        if base is not None:
            return PricePoint(base.unit_cents, currency, "schedule")
        shop = self.settings.default_currency
        if currency == shop:
            return PricePoint(product.price_cents, currency, "list_price")
        converted = self.rates.convert(product.price_cents, shop, currency, at.date())
        return PricePoint(apply_ending(converted, currency), currency, "converted")

    def price(self, product: Product, qty: int = 1, *, currency: str | None = None, tier: str = "standard",
              at: datetime) -> PricePoint:
        currency = currency or self.settings.default_currency
        if qty < 1:
            raise ValueError("qty must be >= 1")
        regular = self.regular_price(product, qty, currency, tier, at)
        point = regular
        sale = self.schedule.best_sale(product.sku, currency, at)
        if sale is not None and sale.unit_cents < regular.unit_cents:
            point = PricePoint(sale.unit_cents, currency, f"sale:{sale.label or 'sale'}",
                               compare_at_cents=regular.unit_cents)
        floor = self.floor_cents(product.sku, currency, at)
        if floor is not None and point.unit_cents < floor:
            log.warning("price for %s %s below floor (%d < %d), using floor", product.sku, currency,
                        point.unit_cents, floor)
            point = PricePoint(floor, currency, point.source, point.compare_at_cents, floored=True)
        return point

    def line_total(self, product: Product, qty: int, *, currency: str | None = None, tier: str = "standard",
                   at: datetime) -> int:
        return self.price(product, qty, currency=currency, tier=tier, at=at).unit_cents * qty

    def cart_prices(self, cart: dict[str, int], products: dict[str, Product], *, currency: str | None = None,
                    tier: str = "standard", at: datetime) -> dict[str, PricePoint]:
        return {sku: self.price(products[sku], qty, currency=currency, tier=tier, at=at)
                for sku, qty in cart.items()}
```

```python
"""Scheduled price changes: sales and permanent price changes that take effect at a set time.

Times are UTC. A sale has an end; a permanent change doesn't. Overlapping sales on one SKU: the
lowest active price wins, which is what customers would pick anyway, and merchandising asked for it
after the "two sales, higher price shown" complaints (SUP-412).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime

from shopkit.errors import Conflict


class ScheduleConflict(Conflict):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ScheduledPrice:
    sku: str
    currency: str
    unit_cents: int
    starts: datetime
    ends: datetime | None = None          # None: permanent from `starts`
    label: str = ""                        # shown on the product page, e.g. "Spring sale"

    def active_at(self, at: datetime) -> bool:
        return self.starts <= at and (self.ends is None or at < self.ends)

    @property
    def is_sale(self) -> bool:
        return self.ends is not None


@dataclass
class Schedule:
    entries: list[ScheduledPrice] = field(default_factory=list)

    def add(self, entry: ScheduledPrice) -> None:
        if entry.ends is not None and entry.ends <= entry.starts:
            raise ValueError("a sale must end after it starts")
        if not entry.is_sale:
            clash = [e for e in self.entries
                     if not e.is_sale and e.sku == entry.sku and e.currency == entry.currency
                     and e.starts == entry.starts]
            if clash:
                raise ScheduleConflict(f"{entry.sku} already has a price change at {entry.starts}",
                                       sku=entry.sku)
        self.entries.append(entry)

    def base_price(self, sku: str, currency: str, at: datetime) -> ScheduledPrice | None:
        """The latest permanent change in effect at `at`."""
        changes = [e for e in self.entries if not e.is_sale and e.sku == sku and e.currency == currency
                   and e.active_at(at)]
        return max(changes, key=lambda e: e.starts) if changes else None

    def best_sale(self, sku: str, currency: str, at: datetime) -> ScheduledPrice | None:
        sales = [e for e in self.entries if e.is_sale and e.sku == sku and e.currency == currency
                 and e.active_at(at)]
        return min(sales, key=lambda e: e.unit_cents) if sales else None

    def upcoming(self, after: datetime, limit: int = 20) -> list[ScheduledPrice]:
        future = sorted((e for e in self.entries if e.starts > after), key=lambda e: e.starts)
        return future[:limit]

    def expire(self, before: datetime) -> int:
        """Drop sales that ended before `before`; returns how many were removed."""
        keep = [e for e in self.entries if not (e.is_sale and e.ends is not None and e.ends <= before)]
        removed = len(self.entries) - len(keep)
        self.entries = keep
        return removed
```

```python
"""Coupon codes: percentage or fixed-amount discounts with validity windows and usage limits."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date

from shopkit.errors import ShopError
from shopkit.utils.numbers import apply_rate

PERCENT, FIXED = "percent", "fixed"


class CouponRejected(ShopError):
    http_status = 422


@dataclass
class Coupon:
    code: str
    kind: str                         # PERCENT or FIXED
    value: int                        # percent (0-100) or cents
    starts: date
    ends: date                        # inclusive
    min_order_cents: int = 0
    max_uses: int | None = None
    uses: int = 0


def coupon_is_active(coupon: Coupon, today: date) -> bool:
    """Within its date window (inclusive) and not used up."""
    within = coupon.starts <= today <= coupon.ends
    return within and (coupon.max_uses is None or coupon.uses < coupon.max_uses)


def discount_cents(coupon: Coupon, order_total_cents: int, today: date) -> int:
    """Discount the coupon gives on an order; never more than the order total.
    Raises CouponRejected with a reason the checkout page can show."""
    if not coupon_is_active(coupon, today):
        raise CouponRejected(f"coupon {coupon.code} is not active", code=coupon.code)
    if order_total_cents < coupon.min_order_cents:
        raise CouponRejected(f"coupon {coupon.code} needs a larger order", code=coupon.code,
                             min_order_cents=coupon.min_order_cents)
    amount = apply_rate(order_total_cents, coupon.value) if coupon.kind == PERCENT else coupon.value
    return min(amount, order_total_cents)


def normalize_code(code: str) -> str:
    return code.strip().upper().replace(" ", "")
```

```python
"""Number formatting for internal reports (CSV/spreadsheet friendly, not customer-facing)."""


def fmt_amount(cents: int) -> str:
    """Plain decimal amount for spreadsheets: no currency symbol, no thousands separator.
    fmt_amount(123456) -> "1234.56"."""
    sign = "-" if cents < 0 else ""
    cents = abs(cents)
    return f"{sign}{cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"


def fmt_percent(ratio: float, digits: int = 1) -> str:
    return f"{ratio * 100:.{digits}f}%"


def fmt_count(n: int) -> str:
    return f"{n:,}"


def pad_table(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:
    """Left-aligned fixed-width text table; first row is the header."""
    if not rows:
        return ""
    widths = [max(len(r[i]) for r in rows) for i in range(len(rows[0]))]
    lines = ["  ".join(cell.ljust(w) for cell, w in zip(row, widths)).rstrip() for row in rows]
    lines.insert(1, "  ".join("-" * w for w in widths))
    return "\n".join(lines)
```

```python
"""Renewals and plan changes.

Proration on a plan change mid-period: the customer gets credit for the unused days of the old plan
and pays for the remaining days of the new plan, both computed per day and rounded to whole cents
(half up). An upgrade is charged immediately (charge = new part - credit); a downgrade never refunds
money: the difference is kept as credit and taken off the next renewal.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from shopkit.subscriptions.plans import ACTIVE, CANCELLED, PAUSED, TRIALING, InvalidSubscriptionState, Plan, PlanSubscription


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Invoice:
    subscription_id: str
    period_start: date
    period_end: date
    amount_cents: int
    credit_applied_cents: int
    description: str


def _per_day(cents: int, days_used: int, days_total: int) -> int:
    value = Decimal(cents) * days_used / days_total
    return int(value.quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))


def proration(sub: PlanSubscription, new_plan: Plan, today: date) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """(credit for the unused part of the current plan, cost of the new plan for the same days).
    During a trial nothing was paid, so the credit is 0."""
    left = sub.days_left(today)
    credit = 0 if sub.status == TRIALING else _per_day(sub.plan.unit_cents, left, sub.days_in_period)
    cost = _per_day(new_plan.unit_cents, left, new_plan.interval_days) if left else 0
    return credit, cost


def change_plan(sub: PlanSubscription, new_plan: Plan, today: date) -> Invoice | None:
    """Switch plans now. Returns the invoice to charge (upgrade) or None (downgrade, credit kept)."""
    if sub.status in (CANCELLED, PAUSED):
        raise InvalidSubscriptionState(f"can't change a {sub.status} subscription", subscription_id=sub.id)
    if new_plan.currency != sub.plan.currency:
        raise ValueError("plan changes keep the currency")
    if new_plan.code == sub.plan.code:
        return None
    credit, cost = proration(sub, new_plan, today)
    old = sub.plan
    sub.plan = new_plan
    sub.history.append((today, f"changed {old.code} -> {new_plan.code}"))
    if cost > credit:
        return Invoice(sub.id, today, sub.period_end, cost - credit, credit,
                       f"Upgrade to {new_plan.name} ({sub.days_left(today)} days)")
    sub.credit_cents += credit - cost
    return None


def renewal_invoice(sub: PlanSubscription, today: date) -> Invoice | None:
    """The invoice for the next period when the current one has ended, else None. Applies carried
    credit. A subscription set to cancel at period end is cancelled instead of renewed."""
    if today < sub.period_end or sub.status in (CANCELLED, PAUSED):
        return None
    if sub.cancel_at_period_end:
        sub.status = CANCELLED
        sub.history.append((today, "ended"))
        return None
    credit = min(sub.credit_cents, sub.plan.unit_cents)
    sub.credit_cents -= credit
    end = sub.period_end.fromordinal(sub.period_end.toordinal() + sub.plan.interval_days)
    return Invoice(sub.id, sub.period_end, end, sub.plan.unit_cents - credit, credit, f"{sub.plan.name} renewal")


def mark_paid(sub: PlanSubscription, invoice: Invoice) -> None:
    if invoice.period_start == sub.period_end:
        sub.advance()
    sub.status = ACTIVE
```

```python
"""Failed renewal payments: retry on a schedule, keep perks during a grace period, then cancel.

Retry schedule (days after the first failure): 1, 3, 5, 7. The subscription is `past_due` while
retrying and keeps its perks until GRACE_DAYS after the period ended; after the last failed retry
it is cancelled and the customer is emailed (notifications.email, template "plan_cancelled").
Cards that fail with a hard decline (stolen, closed account) skip the remaining retries.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, timedelta

from shopkit.subscriptions.plans import CANCELLED, PAST_DUE, PlanSubscription

RETRY_DAYS = (1, 3, 5, 7)
GRACE_DAYS = 7
HARD_DECLINES = {"stolen_card", "lost_card", "account_closed", "do_not_honor_permanent"}


@dataclass
class DunningState:
    subscription_id: str
    first_failure: date
    attempts: int = 0
    last_code: str = ""
    done: bool = False
    log: list[tuple[date, str]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def next_attempt(self) -> date | None:
        if self.done or self.attempts >= len(RETRY_DAYS):
            return None
        return self.first_failure + timedelta(days=RETRY_DAYS[self.attempts])


def start(sub: PlanSubscription, today: date, decline_code: str) -> DunningState:
    sub.status = PAST_DUE
    state = DunningState(sub.id, today, last_code=decline_code)
    state.log.append((today, f"renewal failed: {decline_code}"))
    if decline_code in HARD_DECLINES:
        state.done = True
    return state


def record_attempt(sub: PlanSubscription, state: DunningState, today: date, *, success: bool,
                   decline_code: str = "") -> str:
    """Record a retry; returns "recovered", "retrying" or "cancelled"."""
    state.attempts += 1
    if success:
        state.done = True
        state.log.append((today, "recovered"))
        return "recovered"
    state.last_code = decline_code
    state.log.append((today, f"retry {state.attempts} failed: {decline_code}"))
    if decline_code in HARD_DECLINES or state.attempts >= len(RETRY_DAYS):
        state.done = True
        sub.status = CANCELLED
        sub.history.append((today, "cancelled after failed payments"))
        return "cancelled"
    return "retrying"


def in_grace(sub: PlanSubscription, today: date) -> bool:
    """Perks continue while past due, for GRACE_DAYS after the period ended."""
    return sub.status == PAST_DUE and today < sub.period_end + timedelta(days=GRACE_DAYS)


def due_today(states: list[DunningState], today: date) -> list[DunningState]:
    return [s for s in states if (d := s.next_attempt()) is not None and d <= today]
```

```python
"""Daily revenue recognition for prepaid periods: an invoice paid for [start, end) is recognised
evenly per day, with the rounding remainder on the last day so the total matches exactly."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta

from shopkit.subscriptions.billing import Invoice


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Recognition:
    ref: str
    day: date
    amount_cents: int


def schedule(invoice: Invoice) -> list[Recognition]:
    days = (invoice.period_end - invoice.period_start).days
    if days <= 0 or invoice.amount_cents == 0:
        return []
    per_day, remainder = divmod(invoice.amount_cents, days)
    out = []
    for i in range(days):
        amount = per_day + (remainder if i == days - 1 else 0)
        out.append(Recognition(f"{invoice.subscription_id}:{invoice.period_start}:{i}",
                               invoice.period_start + timedelta(days=i), amount))
    return out


def recognised_through(invoice: Invoice, day: date) -> int:
    """Revenue recognised from an invoice up to and including `day`."""
    return sum(r.amount_cents for r in schedule(invoice) if r.day <= day)


def deferred_balance(invoices: list[Invoice], day: date) -> int:
    """Paid but not yet recognised at the end of `day` (the deferred revenue liability)."""
    return sum(i.amount_cents - recognised_through(i, day) for i in invoices)
```

```python
"""Routing new tickets to a queue and priority by keywords, order value and customer tier, and macros
(canned replies with placeholders)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

from shopkit.support.tickets import Ticket

KEYWORD_QUEUES = [
    (re.compile(r"\b(refund|charged twice|chargeback|money back)\b", re.I), "billing"),
    (re.compile(r"\b(where is|tracking|not arrived|late|delivery)\b", re.I), "shipping"),
    (re.compile(r"\b(broken|damaged|defect|wrong item|missing)\b", re.I), "returns"),
    (re.compile(r"\b(password|log ?in|account|email change)\b", re.I), "accounts"),
    (re.compile(r"\b(invoice|vat|tax|receipt)\b", re.I), "billing"),
]
URGENT_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(lawyer|legal action|fraud|stolen|police)\b", re.I)


def route(t: Ticket, *, order_total_cents: int = 0, tier: str = "standard") -> Ticket:
    text = t.subject + " " + (t.messages[0].body if t.messages else "")
    for pattern, queue in KEYWORD_QUEUES:
        if pattern.search(text):
            t.queue = queue
            break
    if URGENT_WORDS.search(text):
        t.priority = "urgent"
        t.tags.add("escalation")
    elif tier == "gold" or order_total_cents >= 50_000:
        t.priority = "high"
    return t


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Macro:
    name: str
    body: str                       # {first_name}, {order_id}, {agent}
    solves: bool = False
    tags: frozenset[str] = frozenset()


MACROS = {
    "where_is_my_order": Macro("where_is_my_order", "Hi {first_name},\n\nYour order {order_id} is on its way. "
                                                    "You can follow it with the tracking link in your shipping email.\n\n{agent}"),
    "refund_done": Macro("refund_done", "Hi {first_name},\n\nWe've refunded order {order_id}. It can take a few "
                                        "business days to show on your statement.\n\n{agent}", solves=True,
                         tags=frozenset({"refunded"})),
    "need_photos": Macro("need_photos", "Hi {first_name},\n\nSorry about that! Could you send us a photo of the "
                                        "item and the packaging?\n\n{agent}"),
}


def render_macro(name: str, *, first_name: str, order_id: str | None, agent: str) -> tuple[str, Macro]:
    macro = MACROS[name]
    body = macro.body.format(first_name=first_name or "there", order_id=order_id or "(your order)", agent=agent)
    return body, macro
```

```python
"""CSV writing for exports and reports (stdlib csv, always \n line endings, header first)."""
import csv
import io
from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence


def to_csv(header: Sequence[str], rows: Iterable[Sequence[object]]) -> str:
    buf = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(header)
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return buf.getvalue()


def read_csv(text: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    """Parse CSV text with a header row into dicts; surrounding whitespace in values is stripped."""
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text))
    return [{k.strip(): (v or "").strip() for k, v in row.items()} for row in reader]
```

```python
"""Identifiers. Internal ids are prefixed random hex; customer-facing codes avoid look-alike characters."""
import secrets

# No 0/O, 1/I/L: these codes get read out over the phone and typed from printed slips.
_CODE_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"


def new_id(prefix: str) -> str:
    """e.g. new_id("ord") -> "ord_3f9a1c2b7d4e"."""
    return f"{prefix}_{secrets.token_hex(6)}"


def short_code(length: int = 8, groups: int = 0) -> str:
    """Random human-friendly code from an unambiguous alphabet, e.g. "K7QM-X2PA" with groups=4.
    groups=0 means no dashes."""
    code = "".join(secrets.choice(_CODE_ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))
    if groups:
        code = "-".join(code[i:i + groups] for i in range(0, len(code), groups))
    return code


def is_short_code(text: str) -> bool:
    return bool(text) and all(c in _CODE_ALPHABET or c == "-" for c in text)
```

```python
"""Integer-cent arithmetic. Money is always int cents; never round through float formatting."""
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal


def apply_rate(cents: int, rate_pct: float | Decimal | str) -> int:
    """`rate_pct` percent of `cents`, rounded half-up to a whole cent (half away from zero).
    apply_rate(1999, 15) -> 300; apply_rate(-1999, 15) -> -300. Used for tax, commission, discounts."""
    value = Decimal(cents) * Decimal(str(rate_pct)) / Decimal(100)
    return int(value.quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))


def split_evenly(cents: int, parts: int) -> list[int]:
    """Split an amount into `parts` integer shares that sum exactly to `cents`; earlier shares get the
    leftover cents. split_evenly(1000, 3) -> [334, 333, 333]."""
    if parts < 1:
        raise ValueError("parts must be >= 1")
    base, extra = divmod(cents, parts)
    return [base + (1 if i < extra else 0) for i in range(parts)]


def safe_ratio(numerator: float, denominator: float) -> float:
    return numerator / denominator if denominator else 0.0
```

```python
import re
import unicodedata


def normalize_sku(raw: str) -> str:
    """Canonical product code: uppercase, separators removed, dash between letter and digit groups."""
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", raw).upper()
    return "-".join(re.findall(r"[A-Z]+|\d+", s))


def slug_for_title(title: str) -> str:
    """URL slug for a product or campaign title."""
    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", ascii_title.lower())
    return "-".join(words)
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Site:
    code: str
    name: str
    country: str = "US"
    services: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"ground", "air"})      # carrier services available at the dock
    safety_stock: int = 0                                         # units per SKU never allocated (store pickups)
    priority: int = 0                                             # lower ships first when several can


@dataclass
class Lot:
    sku: str
    site: str
    bin: str
    qty: int
    expires: date | None = None
    received: date | None = None


@dataclass
class SiteStock:
    """Lots per site. Allocation takes from lots (FEFO: first expiring first, then oldest received)."""
    lots: list[Lot] = field(default_factory=list)

    def available(self, site: str, sku: str, on: date | None = None) -> int:
        return sum(l.qty for l in self.lots if l.site == site and l.sku == sku and l.qty > 0
                   and (on is None or l.expires is None or l.expires >= on))

    def fefo(self, site: str, sku: str, on: date) -> list[Lot]:
        usable = [l for l in self.lots if l.site == site and l.sku == sku and l.qty > 0
                  and (l.expires is None or l.expires >= on)]
        return sorted(usable, key=lambda l: (l.expires or date.max, l.received or date.min, l.bin))

    def take(self, lot: Lot, qty: int) -> None:
        if qty > lot.qty:
            raise ValueError(f"lot {lot.bin}/{lot.sku} has {lot.qty}, can't take {qty}")
        lot.qty -= qty
```

```python
"""Pick waves: paid orders are grouped into waves per site and allocated to bins before pickers
get their lists. Released waves go to the WMS (core.order_engine.handleWmsCallback brings status back)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import time
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

from shopkit.config import SETTINGS, Settings
from shopkit.events import BUS, EventBus
from shopkit.orders.models import Order
from shopkit.warehouse.sites import Lot, Site, SiteStock

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

EXPRESS, STANDARD = "express", "standard"
MAX_WAVE_ORDERS = 200
MAX_WAVE_LINES = 1200
SHORT_PICK_TOLERANCE = 0          # units an order may be short and still ship (ops set it to 0 after INC-2418)
OVERSELL_ALERT_UNITS = 5


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WaveOrder:
    order: Order
    service: str = STANDARD                 # express | standard
    paid_at: datetime | None = None
    country: str = "US"
    gift: bool = False
    hold: str = ""                          # fraud review, address check... non-empty = not allocatable


@dataclass
class Allocation:
    order_id: str
    sku: str
    site: str
    bin: str
    qty: int
    lot_expires: date | None = None


@dataclass
class Wave:
    id: str
    site: str
    service: str
    created: datetime
    allocations: list[Allocation] = field(default_factory=list)
    orders: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    released: bool = False


@dataclass
class WaveResult:
    waves: list[Wave] = field(default_factory=list)
    backordered: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)    # order -> sku -> missing units
    skipped: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)                   # order -> reason
    stats: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)


def allocate_wave(orders: list[WaveOrder], sites: list[Site], stock: SiteStock, *, today: date,
                  hazmat_skus: frozenset[str] = frozenset(), now: datetime | None = None,
                  settings: Settings = SETTINGS, bus: EventBus = BUS, wave_id=None,
                  metrics: dict | None = None, shadow_split=None) -> WaveResult:
    """Allocate paid orders to sites and bins and group them into waves (one per site and service).

    Orders are taken express first, then oldest paid first. Each order is allocated whole from one
    site when any site can do that (the site with the lowest priority value wins, ties by code); else
    it is split across sites line by line; else what's missing is backordered and the rest waits
    (no partial shipments, see SHORT_PICK_TOLERANCE). Within a site, lots are taken first-expiring
    first and a site's safety stock is never allocated.

    shadow_split: optional callable(order, {site: {sku: qty}}) -> (plan, missing), the old engine's
    splitter (core.order_engine.splitForShipping), compared and logged during INC-2418."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    now = now or datetime.combine(today, datetime.min.time())
    trace = settings.flag("wave_trace")
    stats = Counter()
    result = WaveResult()
    wave_id = wave_id or (lambda site, service, n: f"wv_{site}_{service}_{now:%Y%m%d%H%M}_{n}")
    sites_by_code = {s.code: s for s in sites}
    waves: dict[tuple[str, str], Wave] = {}
    wave_lines: Counter = Counter()
    log.info("INC-2418 allocate_wave start orders=%d sites=%s today=%s", len(orders), [s.code for s in sites], today)

    # --- INC-2418: snapshot of availability before allocation, to detect overselling afterwards ------------
    before: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    for lot in stock.lots:
        k = (lot.site, lot.sku)
        before[k] = before.get(k, 0) + (lot.qty if (lot.expires is None or lot.expires >= today) else 0)
    demanded = Counter()
    for wo in orders:
        for line in wo.order.lines:
            demanded[line.sku] += line.qty
    for sku, qty in demanded.items():
        supply = sum(v for (site, s), v in before.items() if s == sku)
        if qty > supply + OVERSELL_ALERT_UNITS:
            log.warning("INC-2418 demand for %s (%d) exceeds supply (%d) by more than %d", sku, qty, supply,
                        OVERSELL_ALERT_UNITS)
            stats["oversell_alerts"] += 1
    t_snapshot = time.perf_counter()

    # --- order of processing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def sort_key(wo: WaveOrder):
        return (0 if wo.service == EXPRESS else 1, wo.paid_at or datetime.max, wo.order.id)
    queue = sorted(orders, key=sort_key)
    # queue = sorted(orders, key=lambda wo: wo.paid_at)     # pre-2025: express orders waited behind old ones

    for wo in queue:
        order = wo.order
        t_order = time.perf_counter()
        if wo.hold:
            result.skipped[order.id] = f"hold: {wo.hold}"
            stats["held"] += 1
            if trace:
                log.info("INC-2418 TRACE order=%s skipped, hold=%s", order.id, wo.hold)
            continue
        if not order.lines:
            result.skipped[order.id] = "no lines"
            stats["empty"] += 1
            continue
        wanted: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for line in order.lines:
            wanted[line.sku] += line.qty
        if trace:
            log.info("INC-2418 TRACE order=%s service=%s wanted=%s gift=%s country=%s", order.id, wo.service,
                     dict(wanted), wo.gift, wo.country)

        # --- which sites may ship this order ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Hazmat (lithium batteries and the like) can only go by ground: an order containing any hazmat
        # SKU is allocated only from sites that have ground service, and it never goes into an express
        # wave (express leaves by air). Such an order is downgraded to a standard wave instead of being
        # refused; customer service emails the customer (event order.service_downgraded).
        has_hazmat = any(sku in hazmat_skus for sku in wanted)
        service = wo.service
        eligible = [s for s in sites if s.country == wo.country or settings.flag("cross_border_fulfillment")]
        if not eligible:
            eligible = list(sites)            # INC-2418 hotfix: never strand an order because of the country filter
            stats["country_fallback"] += 1
        if has_hazmat:
            ground = [s for s in eligible if "ground" in s.services]
            if len(ground) < len(eligible):
                log.info("INC-2418 order %s has hazmat, %d of %d sites excluded", order.id,
                         len(eligible) - len(ground), len(eligible))
            eligible = ground
            if service == EXPRESS:
                service = STANDARD
                stats["hazmat_downgraded"] += 1
                bus.publish("order.service_downgraded", order_id=order.id, reason="hazmat", to=STANDARD)
        if not eligible:
            result.skipped[order.id] = "no eligible site"
            stats["no_site"] += 1
            log.warning("INC-2418 order %s: no eligible site (hazmat=%s, country=%s)", order.id, has_hazmat, wo.country)
            continue
        eligible.sort(key=lambda s: (s.priority, s.code))

        # --- availability per eligible site, minus safety stock -----------------------------------------------
        avail: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
        for s in eligible:
            avail[s.code] = {sku: max(stock.available(s.code, sku, today) - s.safety_stock, 0) for sku in wanted}
        if trace:
            log.info("INC-2418 TRACE order=%s availability=%s", order.id, json.dumps(avail, sort_keys=True))

        # --- single site if possible ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        plan: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
        whole = [code for code in avail if all(avail[code][sku] >= q for sku, q in wanted.items())]
        if whole:
            plan[whole[0]] = dict(wanted)
            stats["single_site"] += 1
        elif wo.gift and not settings.flag("split_gift_orders"):
            # gift orders arrive as one parcel or not at all (the gift message prints on the first parcel only)
            result.backordered[order.id] = {sku: q - max(avail[c][sku] for c in avail) for sku, q in wanted.items()
                                            if max(avail[c][sku] for c in avail) < q}
            if not result.backordered[order.id]:
                result.backordered[order.id] = {"__split_needed__": 1}
            stats["gift_waiting"] += 1
            continue
        else:
            remaining = dict(wanted)
            for code in avail:
                for sku in list(remaining):
                    take = min(avail[code][sku], remaining[sku])
                    if take > 0:
                        plan.setdefault(code, {})[sku] = plan.get(code, {}).get(sku, 0) + take
                        remaining[sku] -= take
                        if remaining[sku] == 0:
                            del remaining[sku]
            missing = {sku: q for sku, q in remaining.items() if q > 0}
            if sum(missing.values()) > SHORT_PICK_TOLERANCE:
                result.backordered[order.id] = missing
                stats["backordered"] += 1
                if trace:
                    log.info("INC-2418 TRACE order=%s backordered %s", order.id, missing)
                continue
            stats["split"] += 1
            if shadow_split is not None:
                try:
                    old_plan, old_missing = shadow_split(order, avail)
                    old_sites = sorted(old_plan) if isinstance(old_plan, dict) else []
                    if old_sites != sorted(plan):
                        log.info("INC-2418 shadow split differs for %s: new %s old %s", order.id, sorted(plan), old_sites)
                        stats["shadow_diff"] += 1
                except Exception as e:                       # the shadow must never break allocation
                    log.warning("INC-2418 shadow split failed for %s: %s", order.id, e)
                    stats["shadow_error"] += 1

        # --- bins and lots (FEFO), wave assignment ------------------------------------------------------------
        for code, skus in plan.items():
            key = (code, service)
            wave = waves.get(key)
            if wave is None or len(wave.orders) >= MAX_WAVE_ORDERS or wave_lines[key] >= MAX_WAVE_LINES:
                n = sum(1 for k in waves if k[0] == code and k[1] == service) + 1
                wave = Wave(wave_id(code, service, n), code, service, now)
                waves[key] = wave
                result.waves.append(wave)
                wave_lines[key] = 0
            for sku, qty in skus.items():
                left = qty
                for lot in stock.fefo(code, sku, today):
                    if left == 0:
                        break
                    take = min(lot.qty, left)
                    stock.take(lot, take)
                    wave.allocations.append(Allocation(order.id, sku, code, lot.bin, take, lot.expires))
                    wave_lines[key] += 1
                    left -= take
                if left:
                    # can't happen unless stock changed between the availability check and here
                    log.error("INC-2418 lost %d units of %s at %s for order %s", left, sku, code, order.id)
                    stats["lost_units"] += left
            if order.id not in wave.orders:
                wave.orders.append(order.id)
        stats["allocated_orders"] += 1
        if (time.perf_counter() - t_order) > 0.2:
            log.warning("INC-2418 slow allocation for %s: %.0f ms", order.id, (time.perf_counter() - t_order) * 1000)

    # --- INC-2418: oversell check after allocation ------------------------------------------------------------
    after: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    for lot in stock.lots:
        k = (lot.site, lot.sku)
        after[k] = after.get(k, 0) + lot.qty
        if lot.qty < 0:
            log.error("INC-2418 negative lot %s/%s at %s: %d", lot.site, lot.sku, lot.bin, lot.qty)
            stats["negative_lots"] += 1
    allocated_units = sum(a.qty for w in result.waves for a in w.allocations)
    consumed = sum(before.values()) - sum(v for k, v in after.items() if k in before)
    if consumed != allocated_units:
        log.error("INC-2418 allocated %d units but stock dropped by %d", allocated_units, consumed)
        stats["unit_mismatch"] += 1
    for s in sites:
        if s.safety_stock:
            for (code, sku), v in after.items():
                if code == s.code and before.get((code, sku), 0) >= s.safety_stock and v < s.safety_stock:
                    log.error("INC-2418 safety stock breached %s/%s: %d < %d", code, sku, v, s.safety_stock)
                    stats["safety_breach"] += 1

    # --- events, metrics --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for w in result.waves:
        bus.publish("wave.created", wave_id=w.id, site=w.site, service=w.service, orders=len(w.orders),
                    lines=len(w.allocations))
    for oid, missing in result.backordered.items():
        bus.publish("order.backordered", order_id=oid, missing=missing)
    stats["waves"] = len(result.waves)
    stats["total_ms"] = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
    stats["snapshot_ms"] = (t_snapshot - t0) * 1000
    result.stats = dict(stats)
    if metrics is not None:
        for k, v in result.stats.items():
            metrics["waves." + k] = metrics.get("waves." + k, 0) + v
    log.info("INC-2418 allocate_wave done %s", json.dumps(result.stats, sort_keys=True))
    return result


def release(wave: Wave, bus: EventBus = BUS) -> dict:
    """Mark a wave released and build the WMS payload (one pick line per allocation)."""
    if wave.released:
        raise ValueError(f"wave {wave.id} already released")
    wave.released = True
    payload = {"wave": wave.id, "site": wave.site, "service": wave.service,
               "picks": [{"order": a.order_id, "sku": a.sku, "bin": a.bin, "qty": a.qty} for a in
                         sorted(wave.allocations, key=lambda a: (a.bin, a.sku, a.order_id))]}
    bus.publish("wave.released", wave_id=wave.id, picks=len(payload["picks"]))
    return payload


def pick_list_text(wave: Wave) -> str:
    """Printable pick list, sorted by bin so the picker walks the aisles once."""
    rows = [f"Wave {wave.id} ({wave.site}, {wave.service})", ""]
    for a in sorted(wave.allocations, key=lambda a: (a.bin, a.sku)):
        rows.append(f"{a.bin:<10} {a.sku:<14} x{a.qty:<4} order {a.order_id}")
    rows.append("")
    rows.append(f"{len(wave.orders)} orders, {sum(a.qty for a in wave.allocations)} units")
    return "\n".join(rows)
```

```python
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from shopkit.core import order_engine as oe


class FakePayments(object):
    def __init__(self, ok=True):
        self.ok = ok
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, orderId, amountCents, token):
        self.calls.append((orderId, amountCents))
        return (True, "pay-1") if self.ok else (False, "declined")


class FakeWms(object):
    def __init__(self, results):
        self.results = list(results)
        self.sent = []

    def send(self, payload):
        self.sent.append(payload)
        return self.results.pop(0) if self.results else (True, "W1")


ADDR = {"name": "Ann", "line1": "1 Main St", "city": "Springfield", "postcode": "12345", "country": "US",
        "email": "ann@example.com"}


class OrderEngineTest(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        oe.clearRetryQueue()
        self.catalog = {"MUG-1": {"price": 19.99, "title": "Mug"}, "TEA-9": {"price": 5.0, "title": "Tea"}}
        self.stock = {"MUG-1": 10, "TEA-9": 1}

    def testParseOrderRef(self):
        self.assertEqual(oe.parseOrderRef("SO-2019-000123"), ("SO", 2019, 123))
        self.assertEqual(oe.parseOrderRef(" sob 2020 45 "), ("SOB", 2020, 45))
        self.assertEqual(oe.parseOrderRef("ORD_1A2B3C4D5E6F"), ("ord", None, "ord_1a2b3c4d5e6f"))
        self.assertIsNone(oe.parseOrderRef("SO-2015-000001"))
        self.assertIsNone(oe.parseOrderRef("hello"))
        self.assertEqual(oe.formatOrderRef("SO", 2019, 123), "SO-2019-000123")

    def testWmsMapping(self):
        self.assertEqual(oe.wmsStatusToShopkit("dsp"), "shipped")
        self.assertEqual(oe.wmsStatusToShopkit("SHT"), "paid")
        self.assertIsNone(oe.wmsStatusToShopkit("XXX"))
        self.assertEqual(oe.wmsStatusToCode("PKD"), oe.STATUS_PACKED)

    def testTotals(self):
        t = oe.calcOrderTotals([{"sku": "a", "qty": 3, "price": 19.99}], taxRate=0.1)
        self.assertEqual(t["subtotal"], 59.97)
        self.assertEqual(t["tax"], 6.0)
        self.assertEqual(t["shipping"], 7.95)
        t2 = oe.calcOrderTotals([{"sku": "a", "qty": 6, "price": 19.99}], taxRate=0.0, discountPct=10)
        self.assertEqual(t2["shipping"], 0.0)          # free shipping looks at the subtotal before discount

    def testProcessOrderHappyPath(self):
        eng = oe.OrderEngine(self.catalog, self.stock, FakePayments(), FakeWms([(True, "W9")]))
        o = oe.OrderRecord("SO-2026-000001", "C1", [{"sku": "MUG-1", "qty": 2}], dict(ADDR))
        ok, code = eng.processOrder(o)
        self.assertTrue(ok)
        self.assertEqual(o.status, oe.STATUS_SENT_TO_WMS)
        self.assertEqual(self.stock["MUG-1"], 8)
        self.assertEqual(o.wmsRef, "W9")

    def testDeclinedPaymentRestoresStock(self):
        eng = oe.OrderEngine(self.catalog, self.stock, FakePayments(ok=False))
        o = oe.OrderRecord("SO-2026-000002", "C1", [{"sku": "MUG-1", "qty": 2}], dict(ADDR))
        ok, code = eng.processOrder(o)
        self.assertFalse(ok)
        self.assertEqual(code, oe.ERR_PAYMENT_DECLINED)
        self.assertEqual(self.stock["MUG-1"], 10)

    def testWmsFailureQueuesRetry(self):
        eng = oe.OrderEngine(self.catalog, self.stock, FakePayments(), FakeWms([(False, "timeout")] * 3))
        o = oe.OrderRecord("SO-2026-000003", "C1", [{"sku": "MUG-1", "qty": 1}], dict(ADDR))
        ok, code = eng.processOrder(o)
        self.assertTrue(ok)
        self.assertEqual(oe.retryQueueSize(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(eng.retryWms(), 1)

    def testValidation(self):
        eng = oe.OrderEngine(self.catalog, self.stock)
        o = oe.OrderRecord("X", lines=[{"sku": "TEA-9", "qty": 2}], address=dict(ADDR))
        self.assertEqual(eng.validateOrder(o), (False, oe.ERR_OUT_OF_STOCK))
        o2 = oe.OrderRecord("Y", lines=[{"sku": "MUG-1", "qty": 1}], address={"name": "x"})
        self.assertEqual(eng.validateOrder(o2)[1], oe.ERR_BAD_ADDRESS)

    def testCallbackShortPick(self):
        eng = oe.OrderEngine(self.catalog, self.stock, FakePayments(), FakeWms([]))
        o = oe.OrderRecord("SO-2026-000004", "C1", [{"sku": "MUG-1", "qty": 3}], dict(ADDR))
        eng.processOrder(o)
        code, msg = eng.handleWmsCallback({"ref": o.orderId, "status": "SHT", "items": [{"sku": "MUG1", "picked": 1}]})
        self.assertEqual(code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(o.shortItems, {"MUG1": 2})
        self.assertEqual(eng.handleWmsCallback({"ref": "nope", "status": "PKD"}), (202, "unknown order, accepted"))

    def testCancelAndRefund(self):
        eng = oe.OrderEngine(self.catalog, self.stock, FakePayments())
        o = oe.OrderRecord("SO-2026-000005", "C1", [{"sku": "MUG-1", "qty": 1}], dict(ADDR))
        eng.processOrder(o, sendToWms=False)
        ok, code, amt = eng.refundOrder(o.orderId, 10.0)
        self.assertTrue(ok)
        self.assertEqual(eng.cancelOrder(o.orderId), (True, oe.ERR_NONE))
        self.assertEqual(eng.cancelOrder(o.orderId), (False, oe.ERR_ALREADY_CANCELLED))

    def testCreditAccounts(self):
        oe.setCreditAccount("B1", 100)
        self.assertEqual(oe.chargeToAccount("B1", 60), (True, oe.ERR_NONE))
        self.assertEqual(oe.chargeToAccount("B1", 60)[0], False)
        self.assertEqual(oe.creditAvailable("B1"), 40.0)

    def testSplitForShipping(self):
        o = oe.OrderRecord("Z", lines=[{"sku": "A", "qty": 2}, {"sku": "B", "qty": 5}])
        plan, missing = oe.splitForShipping(o, {"W1": {"A": 2, "B": 2}, "W2": {"B": 2}})
        self.assertEqual(plan["W1"][0], {"sku": "A", "qty": 2})
        self.assertEqual(missing, {"B": 1})

    def testCsvImportDryRun(self):
        eng = oe.OrderEngine(self.catalog, self.stock)
        csvText = ("order,customer,sku,qty,price,name,line1,city,postcode,country\n"
                   "T1,B1,mug-1,2,\"12,50\",Ann,1 Main,X,123,us\n"
                   "T2,B1,MUG-1,x,,Ann,1 Main,X,123,us\n")
        created, errors = oe.importOrdersCsv(csvText, eng, dryRun=True)
        self.assertEqual([o.orderId for o in created], ["T1"])
        self.assertEqual(created[0].lines[0]["price"], 12.5)
        # the bad row is reported, and its order (created before the row failed) shows up as empty
        self.assertEqual(errors, ["line 3: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'x'", "order T2: Order has no items"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```python
def test_entries_must_balance_and_use_known_accounts():
    j = Journal()
    with pytest.raises(Unbalanced):
        j.post(D, "x", [dr(A.BANK, 100), cr(A.SALES_REVENUE, 90)])
    with pytest.raises(UnknownAccount):
```

```python
TODAY = date(2026, 3, 10)


def test_admin_commands(tmp_path):
    ctx = Context(db=connect(migrate=False))
    assert main(["migrate"], ctx) == 0 and "applied" in ctx.out[-1]
    assert main(["migrate", "--status"], ctx) == 0 and ctx.out[-1].endswith("applied")

    main(["import-products", str(f)], ctx)
    assert "MUG-1" in ctx.products and ctx.search.search("mug")[0][0] == "MUG-1"
    s = tmp_path / "s.txt"
    s.write_text("MUG000000001" + "01" + "        4" + "        0" + "\nEOF 1\n")
    main(["stock-file", str(s)], ctx)
    assert ctx.stock["MAIN"].available("MUG-1") == 4
    ctx.sellers = [Seller("S1", "x", tax_id="1")]
    ctx.earnings = [Earning("S1", "O1", "MUG-1", 10_000, date(2026, 1, 1))]
    assert main(["payouts", "--start", "2026-03-02", "--end", "2026-03-08", "--approve-by", "fin"], ctx) == 0
    assert any(" approved 8500" in line for line in ctx.out)
    assert main(["close-month", "2026-3"], ctx) == 0 and main(["close-month", "march"], ctx) == 2
    assert main(["stock-file", str(tmp_path / "nope")], ctx) == 2


def test_audiences_consent_suppression_caps_and_holdout():
    camp = Campaign("Spring Sale", date(2026, 3, 1), date(2026, 3, 31))
    customers = [Customer(f"C{i}", f"c{i}@example.com", f"C {i}", marketing_opt_in=i != 0) for i in range(40)]
    log = SendLog()
    for _ in range(MAX_SENDS_PER_WEEK):
        log.record("C1", date(2026, 3, 8))
    aud = build_audience(camp, customers, {}, TODAY, suppressed={"c2@example.com"}, send_log=log, holdout_pct=10)
    assert aud.excluded["C0"] == "no consent" and aud.excluded["C2"] == "suppressed" and aud.excluded["C1"] == "frequency cap"
    held = [c.id for c in customers if aud.excluded.get(c.id) == "holdout"]
    assert held and all(in_holdout(cid, camp.handle, 10) for cid in held)
    seg = build_audience(camp, customers[:5], {"C3": Activity("C3", date(2025, 1, 1), 1, 100)}, TODAY, segments={"lapsed"},
                         holdout_pct=0)
    assert [c.id for c in seg.recipients] == ["C3"]
    assert build_audience(camp, customers, {}, date(2026, 5, 1)).size == 0
    assert lift(30, 1000, 2, 100) == 0.5 and lift(1, 1, 0, 10) is None

    assert b.available(stock) == 2 and b.explode(2) == [("MUG", 2), ("TEA", 4)]
    with pytest.raises(BundleError):
```

```python
import unittest
from datetime import date

from shopkit.catalog.models import Product
from shopkit.core import erp


class ErpTest(unittest.TestCase):

    def testSkuMapping(self):
        self.assertEqual(erp.toErpSku("MUG-1"), "MUG000000001")
        self.assertEqual(erp.toErpSku("tea-set-12"), "TEASET000012")
        self.assertEqual(erp.toErpSku("GIFTCARD"), "GIFTCARD0000")
        self.assertEqual(erp.fromErpSku("MUG000000001", ["X-1", "MUG-1"]), "MUG-1")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            erp.toErpSku("ABCDEFGHIJKLM1")

    def testAmounts(self):
        self.assertEqual(erp.erpAmount(123450), "1234.50")
        self.assertEqual(erp.erpAmount(-5), "-0.05")
        self.assertEqual(erp.parseErpAmount("12,5"), 1250)

    def testStockFile(self):
        rec = lambda item, wh, on, bl: item + wh + str(on).rjust(9) + str(bl).rjust(9)
        text = "\n".join(["* header", rec("MUG000000001", "01", 10, 3), rec("MUG000000001", "05", 9, 0),
                          rec("MUG000000001", "02", "4-", 0), rec("ZZZ000000001", "01", 1, 0), "EOF 4"])
        levels, warnings = erp.parseStockFile(text, ["MUG-1"])
        self.assertEqual(levels, {("MAIN", "MUG-1"): 7, ("EAST", "MUG-1"): 0})
        self.assertEqual(len(warnings), 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            erp.parseStockFile(rec("MUG000000001", "01", 1, 0) + "\nEOF 2", ["MUG-1"])

    def testPushInvoiceRetriesThenSucceeds(self):
        replies = ["<Reply status='ERR'><Error code='E500'>busy</Error></Reply>", "<Reply status='OK' ref='R1'/>"]
        sync = erp.ErpSync(lambda body, headers: replies.pop(0), secret="s", sleep=lambda s: None)
        inv = {"number": "INV-1", "date": date(2026, 3, 1), "lines": [{"sku": "MUG-1", "qty": 1, "unitCents": 1000}]}
        self.assertEqual(sync.pushInvoice(inv), (True, "R1"))
        self.assertEqual(sync.pushInvoice(inv), (True, "dup"))

    def testValidationErrorIsNotRetried(self):
        calls = []
        def transport(body, headers):
            calls.append(1)
            return "<Reply status='ERR'><Error code='E101'>bad item</Error></Reply>"
        sync = erp.ErpSync(transport, sleep=lambda s: None)
        ok, err = sync.pushInvoice({"number": "INV-2", "date": date(2026, 3, 1), "lines": [{"sku": "A-1", "qty": 1, "unitCents": 1}]})
        self.assertFalse(ok)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)

    def testSyncProductsOverwritesTitles(self):
        products = {"MUG-1": Product("MUG-1", "Mug", 1000)}
        n = erp.ErpSync().syncProducts([{"item": "MUG000000001", "desc": "Mug large", "price": "12.00", "active": "Y"}], products)
        self.assertEqual(n, 1)
        self.assertEqual((products["MUG-1"].title, products["MUG-1"].price_cents), ("Mug large", 1200))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```python
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest

from shopkit.errors import Conflict
from shopkit.events import EventBus
from shopkit.fraud.rules import OrderFacts, evaluate
from shopkit.fraud.scoring import ACCEPT, REJECT, REVIEW, ReviewQueue, assess, rule_stats

AT = datetime(2026, 3, 10, 12)


def _facts(**kw):
    base = dict(order_id="O1", customer_id="C1", email="ann@example.com", total_cents=5_000, currency="USD",
                billing_country="US", shipping_country="US")
    base.update(kw)
    return OrderFacts(**base)


def test_clean_order_is_accepted_and_trusted_customers_get_negative_points():
    assert assess(_facts(), AT).decision == ACCEPT
    trusted = assess(_facts(previous_orders=9, account_age_days=400, shipping_country="CA"), AT)
    assert trusted.score == 0 and trusted.decision == ACCEPT


def test_risky_orders_review_or_reject():
    a = assess(_facts(email="x@mailinator.com", shipping_country="CA", card_country="GB"), AT)
    assert {s.code for s in a.signals} == {"disposable_email", "country_mismatch", "card_country"} and a.decision == REVIEW
    r = assess(_facts(recent_orders_same_card=6, previous_chargebacks=1, skus=["GC50", "GC100"]), AT)
    assert r.decision == REJECT


def test_chargeback_history_always_reviewed():
    a = assess(_facts(previous_chargebacks=1, previous_orders=10, account_age_days=500), AT, review_at=60)
    assert a.score == 40 and a.decision == REVIEW          # under review_at, but a chargeback forces review


def test_private_ip_ignored_bad_ip_flagged():
    assert evaluate(_facts(ip="10.0.0.5", ip_country="DE")) == []
    assert [s.code for s in evaluate(_facts(ip="999.1.1.1"))] == ["bad_ip"]


def test_review_queue_flow_and_sla():
    q = ReviewQueue(bus=EventBus())
    q.add(assess(_facts(order_id="O1", email="x@yopmail.com", shipping_country="CA"), AT))
    q.add(assess(_facts(order_id="O2", email="y@yopmail.com", shipping_country="CA"), AT - timedelta(hours=5)))
    assert q.under_review("O1") and not q.under_review("O3")
    q.claim("O1", "ann")
    with pytest.raises(Conflict):
        q.claim("O1", "bo")
    q.decide("O1", "ann", REJECT, AT)
    assert not q.under_review("O1") and q.expire(AT) == ["O2"]
    assert rule_stats(list(q.items.values()))["disposable_email"] == {"seen": 2, "rejected": 1}
```

```python
    po = PurchaseOrder("PO-1", "ACME", [("TEA-9", 12, 300)], date(2026, 3, 20))

    t = [1000.0]
    calls = []
    def transport(*key):
        calls.append(key)
        if len(calls) == 2:
            raise TimeoutError
        return 8.875
    tp = TaxProvider(transport, clock=lambda: t[0])
    assert tp.rate("US", "NY", "10001-1234") == 8.875 and tp.rate("US", "NY", "10001") == 8.875 and len(calls) == 1
    assert tp.rate("US", "CA", "94110") == 7.25 and tp.fallbacks == 1          # provider failed: static table
    assert tp.rate("US", "TX", "73301") == 6.25 and len(calls) == 2            # backing off, no call
    t[0] += FAILURE_BACKOFF_S + 1
    assert tp.rate("US", "TX", "73301") == 8.875 and tp.rate("DE") == 19.0


def test_carrier_labels_and_tracking():
    def transport(path, body):
        if path == "/labels":
            return 201, json.dumps({"tracking_number": "1Z9", "label": "UERG"})
```

```python
    assert svc.board.status("O2") == "cancelled" and svc.bus.history[-1].payload["was_paid"]
```

```python
def _batch(sellers, earnings, adjustments=(), rollover=None, holds=None, **kw):

                              rollover=rollover or Rollover(), **kw)


def test_commission_refunds_and_net():
    s = Seller("S1", "Pots & Co")
    res = _batch([s], [Earning("S1", "O1", "POT", 10_000, OLD), Earning("S1", "O2", "PAN", 5_000, OLD, refunded_cents=1_000)])

    assert res.payouts[0].lines[0].net_cents == 0 and res.payouts[0].lines[0].commission_cents == 0


def test_recent_deliveries_are_held_and_released_later():
    holds = HoldBook()

    assert res.payouts[0].held_cents == 8_500 and res.payouts[0].status == ROLLED_OVER     # nothing left to pay
    later = build_payout_batch([s], [], [], date(2026, 4, 6), date(2026, 4, 12), holds=holds, rollover=Rollover())
    assert later.payouts[0].adjustments_cents == 8_500


def test_small_payouts_roll_over_unless_the_seller_is_closing():
    rollover = Rollover()
    tiny = [Earning("S1", "O1", "PIN", 2_000, OLD), Earning("S2", "O2", "PIN", 2_000, OLD)]
    res = _batch([Seller("S1", "x"), Seller("S2", "y", status=CLOSING)], tiny, rollover=rollover)

    assert by["S2"].status == DRAFT and by["S2"].net_cents == 1_700 < MIN_PAYOUT_CENTS
    nxt = _batch([Seller("S1", "x")], [Earning("S1", "O3", "PIN", 2_000, OLD)], rollover=rollover)

def test_suspended_sellers_skipped_and_bad_earnings_rejected():

    p = res.payouts[0]

    # net 75_000 USD -> 67_500 EUR - 1.5% fee (1_013) = 66_487
```

```python
from shopkit.subscriptions.billing import change_plan, mark_paid, proration, renewal_invoice

    today = D + timedelta(days=10)                                                # 20 days left
    credit, cost = proration(sub, BUSINESS, today)
    assert (credit, cost) == (666, 3267)
    inv = change_plan(sub, BUSINESS, today)

    sub.resume(D + timedelta(days=12))

    sub.cancel(D + timedelta(days=20))
```

```python
from datetime import date, datetime

import pytest

from shopkit.accounting import accounts as A
from shopkit.accounting.journal import Journal
from shopkit.config import Settings
from shopkit.events import EventBus
from shopkit.payments.models import CAPTURED, Payment
from shopkit.payments.refunds import RefundTooLarge
from shopkit.payments.settlement import (ProviderError, RefundRequest, RefundsPaused, SettlementLedger,
                                         settle_refund)

TODAY = date(2026, 3, 10)


class Provider:
    def __init__(self, fail=0):
        self.fail, self.calls = fail, []

    def refund(self, pid, amount, key):
        self.calls.append((pid, amount, key))
        if self.fail:
            self.fail -= 1
            raise RuntimeError("provider 503")
        return f"pr_{len(self.calls)}"


class GiftCards:
    def issue(self, amount, customer_id):
        return f"GC-{amount}"


def _pay(pid, amount, created, method="card"):
    return Payment(pid, "O1", amount, "USD", method, status=CAPTURED, created=created)


def _settle(req, payments, **kw):
    kw.setdefault("provider", Provider())
    kw.setdefault("journal", Journal())
    kw.setdefault("ledger", SettlementLedger())
    return settle_refund(req, payments, customer_id="C1", today=TODAY, bus=EventBus(), sleep=lambda s: None, **kw)


def test_recent_card_payment_refunds_to_card_and_books_ledger():
    j = Journal()
    s = _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 1_000, 80, 0, "damaged", "ann"), [_pay("P1", 5_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1))], journal=j)
    assert s.to_card_cents == 1_080 and s.provider_refs == ["pr_1"]
    assert j.balance(A.CASH_CLEARING.code) == -1_080 and j.balance(A.SALES_TAX_PAYABLE.code) == -80


def test_old_card_payment_goes_to_store_credit():
    ledger = SettlementLedger()
    provider = Provider()
    s = _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 1_000, 0, 0, "damaged", "ann"), [_pay("P1", 5_000, datetime(2025, 8, 1))],
                ledger=ledger, provider=provider)
    assert s.to_store_credit_cents == 1_000 and provider.calls == [] and ledger.store_credit["C1"] == 1_000


def test_split_payment_gift_card_gets_its_share_and_remainder_goes_to_card():
    s = _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 1_001, 0, 0, "damaged", "ann"),
                [_pay("P1", 3_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1)), _pay("G1", 1_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1), "gift_card")],
                gift_cards=GiftCards())
    assert (s.to_card_cents, s.to_gift_card_cents, s.gift_card_code) == (751, 250, "GC-250")


def test_idempotency_and_too_large():
    ledger = SettlementLedger()
    provider = Provider()
    req = RefundRequest("O1", 500, 0, 0, "damaged", "ann", idempotency_key="k1")
    pays = [_pay("P1", 5_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1))]
    first = _settle(req, pays, ledger=ledger, provider=provider)
    assert _settle(req, pays, ledger=ledger, provider=provider) is first and len(provider.calls) == 1
    with pytest.raises(RefundTooLarge):
        _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 9_000, 0, 0, "damaged", "ann"), pays)


def test_provider_retries_and_kill_switch():
    provider = Provider(fail=2)
    s = _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 500, 0, 0, "damaged", "ann"), [_pay("P1", 5_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1))], provider=provider)
    assert len(provider.calls) == 3 and s.to_card_cents == 500
    with pytest.raises(ProviderError):
        _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 500, 0, 0, "x", "ann"), [_pay("P1", 5_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1))], provider=Provider(fail=9))
    with pytest.raises(RefundsPaused):
        _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 500, 0, 0, "x", "ann"), [_pay("P1", 5_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1))],
                settings=Settings(feature_flags={"refunds_paused": True}))
    old = _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 500, 0, 0, "x", "ann"), [_pay("P1", 5_000, datetime(2025, 1, 1))],
                  settings=Settings(feature_flags={"refunds_paused": True}))
    assert old.to_store_credit_cents == 500


def test_metrics_and_mixed_ledger_split():
    metrics, j = {}, Journal()
    s = _settle(RefundRequest("O1", 1_000, 100, 0, "damaged", "ann"),
                [_pay("P1", 2_000, datetime(2026, 3, 1)), _pay("P2", 2_000, datetime(2025, 1, 1))], journal=j, metrics=metrics)
    assert s.to_card_cents + s.to_store_credit_cents == 1_100 and metrics["refunds.count"] == 1
    assert j.balance(A.CUSTOMER_CREDIT.code) == s.to_store_credit_cents
```

```python
                       ' {"sku": "TEA9", "price_cents": 199}, {"sku": "X1", "price_cents": 5}, {"sku": "Y"}]}')

    assert report.held == [("TEA-9", 1000, 199)] and held == [("TEA-9", 1000, 199)]
    assert products["TEA-9"].price_cents == 1000 and report.unknown == ["X-1"] and len(report.errors) == 1
    dry = apply_updates([{"sku": "tea 9", "price_cents": 900}], products, dry_run=True)
    assert dry.updated == ["TEA-9"] and products["TEA-9"].price_cents == 1000
    diff = diff_sheet("sku,title,price\nMUG1,Blue mug XL,21.00\nNEW1,New,1.00\n", products)
```

```python
    assert late.id != t.id and f"follow_up:{t.id}" in late.tags
    assert desk.close_solved(MON + timedelta(days=5)) == [t.id]
    with pytest.raises(TicketClosed):
```

```python
from datetime import date, datetime

from shopkit.config import Settings
from shopkit.core.order_engine import OrderRecord, splitForShipping
from shopkit.events import EventBus
from shopkit.orders.models import Order, OrderLine
from shopkit.warehouse.sites import Lot, Site, SiteStock
from shopkit.warehouse.waves import EXPRESS, STANDARD, WaveOrder, allocate_wave, pick_list_text, release

TODAY = date(2026, 3, 10)
MAIN = Site("MAIN", "Main", priority=0)
EAST = Site("EAST", "East", priority=1, services=frozenset({"air"}))


def _stock(*lots):
    return SiteStock([Lot(*l) for l in lots])


def _o(oid, *lines, **kw):
    return WaveOrder(Order(oid, [OrderLine(s, q, 100) for s, q in lines]), **kw)


def test_single_site_fefo_and_waves_per_service():
    stock = _stock(("MUG", "MAIN", "A1", 5, date(2026, 6, 1)), ("MUG", "MAIN", "A2", 5, date(2026, 4, 1)),
                   ("MUG", "EAST", "B1", 5))
    bus = EventBus()
    res = allocate_wave([_o("O1", ("MUG", 6), service=EXPRESS, paid_at=datetime(2026, 3, 9)),
                         _o("O2", ("MUG", 1), paid_at=datetime(2026, 3, 8))], [MAIN, EAST], stock, today=TODAY, bus=bus)
    express = next(w for w in res.waves if w.service == EXPRESS)
    assert [(a.bin, a.qty) for a in express.allocations] == [("A2", 5), ("A1", 1)]
    assert {w.service for w in res.waves} == {EXPRESS, STANDARD} and res.stats["single_site"] == 2


def test_hazmat_only_from_ground_sites_and_never_express():
    stock = _stock(("BATT", "EAST", "B1", 5), ("BATT", "MAIN", "A1", 1))
    bus = EventBus()
    res = allocate_wave([_o("O1", ("BATT", 1), service=EXPRESS)], [MAIN, EAST], stock, today=TODAY,
                        hazmat_skus=frozenset({"BATT"}), bus=bus)
    assert [(w.site, w.service) for w in res.waves] == [("MAIN", STANDARD)]
    assert any(e.name == "order.service_downgraded" for e in bus.history)
    res2 = allocate_wave([_o("O2", ("BATT", 3))], [MAIN, EAST], stock, today=TODAY, hazmat_skus=frozenset({"BATT"}),
                         bus=EventBus())
    assert res2.backordered == {"O2": {"BATT": 3}}            # EAST has 5 but only ships by air


def test_split_backorder_gift_and_safety_stock():
    stock = _stock(("MUG", "MAIN", "A1", 2), ("MUG", "EAST", "B1", 2), ("TEA", "MAIN", "A9", 1))
    res = allocate_wave([_o("O1", ("MUG", 3)), _o("O2", ("TEA", 2))], [MAIN, EAST], stock, today=TODAY, bus=EventBus())
    assert res.stats["split"] == 1 and res.backordered == {"O2": {"TEA": 1}}
    gift = allocate_wave([_o("G1", ("MUG", 1), gift=True)], [MAIN, EAST], _stock(("MUG", "MAIN", "A1", 1)),
                         today=TODAY, bus=EventBus())
    assert gift.stats["single_site"] == 1
    g2 = allocate_wave([_o("G2", ("MUG", 3), gift=True)], [MAIN, EAST], _stock(("MUG", "MAIN", "A1", 2), ("MUG", "EAST", "B", 2)),
                       today=TODAY, bus=EventBus())
    assert "G2" in g2.backordered and g2.waves == []
    safe = Site("MAIN", "Main", safety_stock=2)
    res3 = allocate_wave([_o("O3", ("MUG", 2))], [safe], _stock(("MUG", "MAIN", "A1", 3)), today=TODAY, bus=EventBus())
    assert res3.backordered == {"O3": {"MUG": 1}}


def test_expired_lots_holds_and_shadow_split():
    stock = _stock(("MILK", "MAIN", "C1", 4, date(2026, 3, 1)), ("MILK", "MAIN", "C2", 1, date(2026, 3, 20)))
    calls = []
    def shadow(order, avail):
        calls.append(order.id)
        return splitForShipping(OrderRecord(order.id, lines=[{"sku": l.sku, "qty": l.qty} for l in order.lines]), avail)
    res = allocate_wave([_o("O1", ("MILK", 2)), _o("O2", ("MILK", 1), hold="fraud review")], [MAIN], stock,
                        today=TODAY, bus=EventBus(), shadow_split=shadow)
    assert res.backordered == {"O1": {"MILK": 1}} and res.skipped == {"O2": "hold: fraud review"}


def test_release_and_pick_list():
    stock = _stock(("MUG", "MAIN", "A1", 5))
    res = allocate_wave([_o("O1", ("MUG", 2))], [MAIN], stock, today=TODAY, bus=EventBus(), metrics={})
    w = res.waves[0]
    payload = release(w, bus=EventBus())
    assert payload["picks"] == [{"order": "O1", "sku": "MUG", "bin": "A1", "qty": 2}]
    assert "A1" in pick_list_text(w) and "1 orders, 2 units" in pick_list_text(w)
```
